property_summary: Across consecutive successful 10-ether fallback calls made at strictly increasing timestamps, C's pastBlockTime must strictly increase (it stores the call's timestamp); the mutant stores block.number instead, which stays constant within a block, so pastBlockTime fails to increase.
change_summary: Replace the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp with pastBlockTime = block.number so the stored value differs and the gating condition behaves differently.
